result.summary: This is a narrow residential street with sidewalks on both sides, though they lack a buffer from the roadway. The environment is characterized by older row houses on one side and a mix of vacant lots and buildings on the other, with no visible traffic calming or marked pedestrian crossings.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Tire planters and protruding building steps on the right side narrow the effective walking width.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross the roadway without designated space.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven sidewalk and roadway surfaces present tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by a vehicle parked directly on the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the street. The walkway itself is in poor condition with significant cracking and uneven surfaces, while the lack of street lighting and presence of blank walls further reduce safety and comfort.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle on sidewalk
hazards.description: A silver sedan is parked directly on the pedestrian walkway, completely blocking passage and forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left of the image, on the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Degraded sidewalk surface
hazards.description: The concrete sidewalk slabs are severely cracked, tilted, and uneven, creating significant trip hazards.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Replace the damaged and uneven concrete slabs with a level, continuous walking surface to eliminate trip hazards.

interventions.title: Bollard Installation
interventions.description: Install physical barriers such as bollards along the curb line to prevent vehicles from parking on and obstructing the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians using the walkway at night.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by fragmented and poorly maintained sidewalks, with significant gaps in the walkway network. The roadway lacks clear lane markings, and the overall design prioritizes vehicle movement over pedestrian safety and comfort.

hazards.name: Fragmented and degraded sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left is narrow, cracked, and disappears into dirt, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crossings or pedestrian warnings at the immediate location despite the presence of residential and commercial land uses.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant concrete sidewalk with a minimum width of 5 feet on both sides of the street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add continental-style crosswalk markings and pedestrian warning signs at intersections and key midblock locations.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Upgrades
interventions.description: Improve pedestrian-scale lighting to ensure the walkway is well-lit and safe for use after dark.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a degraded sidewalk area in front of an industrial building with a blank frontage. There is a total lack of formal pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crossings, street lighting, or buffers from the roadway.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is cracked and uneven, creating significant trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground sidewalk area in front of the building.

hazards.name: Lack of Lighting
hazards.description: No street lights are visible, which would make the area unsafe for pedestrians at night.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The industrial building and fenced lot provide no active surveillance or visual interest, reducing perceived safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lamps to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.
